notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Some artwork has been reworked to match the game's pixel art style.

Some buildings in the city have been enhanced.

5 potential women to flirt with are available throughout the game. Don't just conquer the tower, but their hearts, too!

Minor bugs have been fixed.
